task.title: Start generated notes for an older line's release candidates at the line's previous release
task.description: Follow-up from the review of "Start generated release notes at the line's previous release" (PR #177, 2026-10-10). scripts/publish-release.sh (~88-90) passes --notes-start-tag only for stable releases; a pre-release still lets GitHub choose the start tag. A release candidate for an older line (e.g. v0.5.3-rc1 after v0.6.0) could therefore get notes compared against v0.6.0. Unreachable today: line branches refuse pre-releases (PR #175, plan-release.sh / cut-release.sh / validate-release-branch.sh). Do this only if line pre-releases are ever allowed: pick the start tag for a candidate the same way as for a stable release on its line, and assert the gh stub's recorded calls.
